annotation.title_clean: From pandemics to artificial intelligence, robots, and transhumanism: New challenges for ethics
annotation.title_en: From pandemics to artificial intelligence, robots, and transhumanism: New challenges for ethics
annotation.summary_en: Bioethics article arguing for a critical but positive view of technoscience, examining the ethics of artificiality, AI, robotics, technostress and virtual isolation, and criticizing transhumanism and post-humanism. It argues technological progress must be guided by human values that technoscience itself cannot supply.
key_provisions_or_claims: Takes an intermediate position between scientism and anti-science regarding technoscience.
Argues the artificial is an expression of human nature, not opposed to it.
Criticizes transhumanism and post-humanism for placing machines above humans.
Holds that technological progress must be steered by values technoscience cannot provide.
Highlights technostress and isolation from digital technology as harms.
